searchText: Hello everyone, not sure if this is the right place for this but we are a group of academics wanting to try and look at some open theorems needing proving..at some point I came across 3 problems still open to be solved but cannot find the page again. Can anyone help please? Thanks🙏 Does anyone know the most optimal way to compute `x%y` where x is a power of two, y is odd? In which language/CPU? Perhaps someone can come up with a fancy mathematical argument using Euler's theorem or similar but I bet a beer that you can't beat the naive approach: it's just two scalar instructions in assembly: a SHL and a DIV
